BOUNDARY: The proof contract already checks the empty metric space, empty cover, singleton space, one‑member cover, degenerate cases, and endpoints; each of these is consistent with the cited theorems. Under Choice every metric space (including empty) is paracompact, and every metrizable space (hence every metric space) is Hausdorff. For the empty space the empty family is an open cover, and the subordinate partition of unity exists vacuously (empty family, sum condition vacuously true). For a non‑empty space the empty family is not a cover, so the hypothesis of the theorem is not satisfied. No counterexample can exist under the given axioms. The proof is a direct composition of two theorems with no index shift, limiting argument, or hidden division, so boundary failures cannot arise.
